slides.sub: Detachment, pivots and deep specialisation: the pruning season.

slides.body: Ketu (the south lunar node, the planet of detachment) dasha runs 7 years. Interest in surface rewards fades. The question becomes "what actually matters?"

slides.h2: Why it differs from Venus Dasha
slides.body: Venus Dasha builds relationships and comfort. Ketu Dasha often loosens attachment to them, and asks you to keep only what is real.

points: Cutting projects that no longer fit
Clarity about what you can drop
Withdrawing from people who support you
Quitting good plans out of restlessness
Making big exits on a low mood

slides.body: Prune on purpose. List what to stop, what to keep and why. Wait before any irreversible exit, so the decision comes from clarity rather than mood.
